# Assistant runs

<!-- Generated by tools/docs/api_reference.py from contracts/openapi; do not edit. -->

Base path: `https://<gateway>/agent-runtime`. Every call needs an API key or a Studio session (see [Authentication](index.md#authentication)). Request and response fields are in the OpenAPI document, `contracts/openapi/agent-runtime.json`.

| Method | Path | What it does | Body | Returns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/v1/agents/{agent}/runs` | Run one turn of an agent on a thread, or resume it after a clarifying question/approval. | `RunIn` | 200 `RunOut` |
| `POST` | `/v1/agents/{agent}/runs/stream` | The same turn as `/runs` as server-sent events. | `RunIn` | 200, event stream |
| `POST` | `/v1/graphs/validate` | Check a declarative graph before publishing it (Domain Pack editor, agent overrides). | object | 200 `GraphCheck` |
| `GET` | `/v1/runs/{run_id}` | A run's step-by-step trace (Answer Inspector). |  | 200 `RunTrace` |
| `GET` | `/v1/threads/{thread_id}/runs` | Thread Runs |  | 200 list of `RunTrace` |
